units: pixels (x right, y DOWN, origin top-left of the 1920x1080 frame) and seconds

camera.motion: static (no background shift; median-background differencing leaves no residue on static objects)
camera.view: frontal view of a classroom back/front wall; wall plane roughly parallel to image plane
camera.perspective_cues: wall/floor junction ~y 950 (horizontal); ceiling lights converge slightly toward the centre; teacher desk top seen slightly from above (top surface back edge y~738, front edge y~765)

cat.description: black cat with white paws/light face, walking left->right along the top of the teacher desk (only animal)
cat.reference_point: cx,cy = centroid of torso mask (tail and thin legs removed by 15 px opening) ~ animal root
cat.direction: +x (rightward), y nearly constant (cy 677-683, oscillates with gait)
cat.occlusion: none; paws stand on desk top (y~742)

arrow.description: thin light-grey arrow (fletching at rear, separate pale arrowhead) flying left->right on an arc across the wall
arrow.reference_point: ref_x,ref_y = arrow mid-point = fletching end + L/2 along shaft (L=132 px); cx,cy = midpoint of visible mask
arrow.thickness_px: about 8-13 px incl. fletching (blur-inflated); shaft ~4 px
arrow.entry: enters through left image edge at frame 7 (only tip visible), fully inside from frame 10
arrow.exit: tip reaches right image edge at frame 38-39, last visible (tail part only) frame 41, gone at 42
arrow.orientation: angle_deg (counter-clockwise from +x, image y up) goes +13 (rising) -> 0 at apex -> -18 (descending); shaft follows the path

teacher_desk.desc: long light-wood desk the cat walks on (left half of image)

wall_clock.desc: round wall clock, dark rim, upper right

chair_center.desc: dark-red chair (back facing camera), centre-left foreground

chair_orange.desc: orange/wood chair against wall, far right

student_desk_left.desc: small desk with dark chair at far left foreground

student_desk_right.desc: small desk behind right dark chair

student_desk_far_right.desc: partly visible desk at right edge

events.what: cat already walking right on desk top (motion starts before clip)
arrow first visible, entering at left edge (x~0-38, y~708)
arrow apex (highest point, min ref_y); vertical direction change up->down between frames 23 and 24
arrow passes above the cat (~150 px higher); no contact
arrow tip reaches right image edge
arrow last visible (leaving right edge); absent from frame 42
clip ends, cat still walking (no stop), cat near right end of desk (front x~795 = desk right end)
